title: Provide prescribed accommodation for pastoral workers
what: As the occupier employing resident pastoral workers, provide them with the accommodation the regulations prescribe.

sources.title: Pastoral Workers' Accommodation Act 1980 (Qld)
sources.quote: Where a worker is a resident worker the occupier on whose behalf the worker is employed shall provide the worker with such accommodation as is prescribed
